43284-wilderness-a-journal-of-quiet-adve.title: A Journal of Quiet Adventure in Alaska
43284-wilderness-a-journal-of-quiet-adve.creator: Rockwell Kent
43284-wilderness-a-journal-of-quiet-adve.description: A book by Rockwell Kent. The air is so clear in the North that one new to it is lost in the crowding of great heights and spaces. Distant peaks had risen over the lower mountains of the shore astern. Steep spruce-clad slopes confronted us. All around was the wilderness, a no-man's-land of mountains or of cragged islands, and southward the wide, the limitless, Pacific Ocean.

arxiv-2011-07308.title: Phase-dependent dissipation and supercurrent of a graphene-superconductor ring under microwave irradiation
arxiv-2011-07308.creator: Ziwei Dou 1 , Taro Wakamura 1 , Pauli Virtanen 2 , Nian-Jheng Wu 1,3 , Richard Deblock 1 , Sandrine Autier-Laurent 1 , Kenji Watanabe 4 , Takashi Taniguchi 4 , Sophie Guéron 1 , Hélène Bouchiat 1 , and Meydi Ferrier 1
arxiv-2011-07308.description: Abstract A junction with two superconductors coupled by a normal metal hosts Andreev bound states whose energy spectrum is phase-dependent and exhibits a minigap, resulting in a periodic supercurrent. Phase-dependent dissipation also appears at finite frequency due to relaxation of Andreev bound states.

Yee, Andrew Gould, Shude Mao, Xiangyu Zhang, Michael D. Albrow, Sun-Ju Chung, Cheongho Han, Youn Kil Jung, Yoon-Hyun Ryu, In-Gu Shin, Yossi Shvartzvald, Sang-Mok Cha, Dong-Jin Kim, Hyoun-Woo Kim, Seung-Le. arxiv-2111-04564.title: Human Activity Recognition using Attribute-Based Neural Networks and Context Information
arxiv-2111-04564.creator: Stefan Lüdtke, Fernando Moya Rueda, Waqas Ahmed, Gernot A. Fink, Thomas Kirste
arxiv-2111-04564.description: Abstract We consider human activity recognition (HAR) from wearable sensor data in manual-work processes, like warehouse order-picking. Such structured domains can often be partitioned into distinct process steps , e.g., packaging or transporting. Each process step can have a different prior distribution over activity classes , e.g., standing or walking, and different system dynamics.

arxiv-2210-17092.title: Confidence-Nets: A Step Towards better Prediction Intervals for regression Neural Networks on small datasets
arxiv-2210-17092.creator: Mohamedelmujtaba Altayeb, Abdelrahman M. Elamin, Hozaifa Ahmed, Eithar Elfatih Elfadil Ibrahim, Omer Haydar, Saba Abdulaziz, Najlaa H. M. Mohamed
arxiv-2210-17092.description: Abstract The recent decade has seen an enormous rise in the popularity of deep learning and neural networks. These algorithms have broken many previous records and achieved remarkable results. Their outstanding performance has significantly sped up the progress of AI, and so far various milestones have been achieved earlier than expected.

arxiv-2212-09215.title: Tidal disruption of stellar clusters and their remnants’ spatial distribution near the galactic center Released on May, 8th, 2022 petar ( Wang et al. 2020a ) , sdar ( Wang et al. 2020b ) , fdps ( Iwasawa et al. 2016 ; Iwasawa et al. 2020 ) , galpy ( Bovy 2015 ) , mcluster ( Küpper et al. 2011 )
arxiv-2212-09215.creator: Long Wang (王龙), D. N. C. Lin (林潮)
arxiv-2212-09215.description: Abstract The accretion of massive star clusters via dynamical friction has previously been established to be a likely scenario for the build up of nuclear stellar clusters (NSCs). A remaining issue is whether strong external tidal perturbation may lead to the severe disruption of loosely-bound clusters well before they sink deeply into the center of their host galaxies.

arxiv-2401-01091.title: Period-Luminosity Relationship for δ \delta Scuti Stars Revisited
arxiv-2401-01091.creator: Atila Poro, S. Javad Jafarzadeh, Roghaye Harzandjadidi, Mohammad Madani, Elnaz Bozorgzadeh, Esfandiar Jahangiri, Ahmad Sarostad, Ailar Alizadehsabegh, Maryam Hadizadeh, Mohammad EsmaeiliVakilabadi
arxiv-2401-01091.description: Abstract The Gaia DR3 parallax approach was used to estimate the absolute parameters of 2375 δ \delta Scuti stars from the ASAS catalog. The selected stars have a variety of observational characteristics, with a higher than 80% probability of being δ \delta Scuti stars.

arxiv-2410-20188.title: Bernstein-Sato functional equations for ideals in positive characteristic
arxiv-2410-20188.creator: Siyong Tao, Zida Xiao, Huaiqing Zuo
arxiv-2410-20188.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Siyong Tao, Zida Xiao, Huaiqing Zuo. For an ideal of a regular ℂ \mathbb{C} -algebra, its Bernstein-Sato polynomial is the monic polynomial of the lowest degree satisfying an Bernstein-Sato functional equation. We generalize the notion of Bernstein-Sato functional equations to the case of ideals in an F F -finite ring of positive characteristic p p , and show the relationship between these equations and Bernstein-Sato roots.

arxiv-2510-26600.title: Higher-order discrete time crystals in a quantum chaotic top
arxiv-2510-26600.creator: Subhashis Das, Vishal Khan, Atanu Rajak
arxiv-2510-26600.description: Abstract We characterize various dynamical phases of the simplest version of the quantum kicked-top model, a paradigmatic system for studying quantum chaos. This system exhibits both regular and chaotic behavior depending on the kick strength. The existence of the 2 2 -DTC phase has previously been reported around the rotationally symmetric point of the system, where it displays regular dynamics.

arxiv-2512-04394.title: Law of Large Numbers for continuous N N -particle ensembles at fixed temperature
arxiv-2512-04394.creator: Cesar Cuenca, Jiaming Xu
arxiv-2512-04394.description: Abstract In this paper, we find necessary and sufficient conditions for the Law of Large Numbers of averaged empirical measures of N N -particle ensembles, in terms of the asymptotics of their Bessel generating functions, in the fixed temperature regime. This settles an open problem posed by Benaych-Georges, Cuenca and Gorin.

arxiv-2602-09146.title: SemanticMoments: Training-Free Motion Similarity via Third Moment Features
arxiv-2602-09146.creator: Saar Huberman, Kfir Goldberg, Or Patashnik, Sagie Benaim, Ron Mokady, BRIA AI Tel Aviv University Hebrew University of Jerusalem
arxiv-2602-09146.description: Abstract Retrieving videos based on semantic motion is a fundamental, yet unsolved, problem. Existing video representation approaches overly rely on static appearance and scene context rather than motion dynamics, a bias inherited from their training data and objectives. Conversely, traditional motion-centric inputs like optical flow lack the semantic grounding needed to understand high-level motion.

pmc-10627683.title: Bibliometric analysis of Kampo medicine hotspots and trends for the decade: 2013–2022
pmc-10627683.creator: Toshihisa Onoda, Hiroyuki Tanaka, Toshihiro Ishii
pmc-10627683.description: Background:Kampo medicine is a traditional medicine that originated in ancient China and has since developed as a uniquely Japanese medicine. Although Kampo medicine is one of Japan’s most important therapeutic modalities and numerous papers have been published recently, information on current hotspots and trends in Kampo research is lacking.

pmc-10688183.title: What Controls the Quality of Photodynamical Simulations? Electronic Structure Versus Nonadiabatic Algorithm
pmc-10688183.creator: Jiří Janoš, Petr Slavíček
pmc-10688183.description: The field of nonadiabatic dynamics has matured over the last decade with a range of algorithms and electronic structure methods available at the moment. While the community currently focuses more on developing and benchmarking new nonadiabatic dynamics algorithms, the underlying electronic structure controls the outcome of nonadiabatic simulations. Yet, the electronic-structure sensitivity analysis is typically neglected.

pmc-10738684.title: QUALITY OF LIFE ASSOCIATED WITH HOSPITAL DEATH AMONG PERSONS LIVING WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-10738684.creator: Suzanne Sullivan, Chin-Shang Li, Yu-Ping Chang
pmc-10738684.description: Dementia is a progressive, terminal health condition impacting quality-of-life. Hospice programs supporting family caregivers in managing end-of-life care for persons living with dementia (PLWD) and preventing non-beneficial hospitalizations are underutilized. This univariable logistic regression of the National Health and Aging Trends Study rounds 1-9 (n=719) aimed to identify associations between quality-of-life of PLWD and hospital death (yes/no).

pmc-10753823.title: Editorial: Modeling and simulation of cerebrospinal fluid disorders
pmc-10753823.creator: Seifollah Gholampour
pmc-10753823.description: nt, in addition to neurological and physical examinations, and patient clinical histories, to provide a nuanced understanding of these disorders and evaluate treatment outcomes. The emergence of bioengineering computer simulation and modeling stands out as a potent and non-invasive tool, providing a quantitative framework for evaluating CSF disorders (Gholampour, 2018).

pmc-11512287.title: Host Response Markers of Inflammation and Endothelial Activation Associated with COVID-19 Severity and Mortality: A GeoSentinel Prospective Observational Cohort
pmc-11512287.creator: Andrea M Weckman, Sarah Anne J Guagliardo, Valerie M Crowley, Lucia Moro, Chiara Piubelli, Tamara Ursini, Sabrina H van Ierssel, Federico G Gobbi, Hannah Emetulu, Aisha Rizwan, Kristina M Angelo, Carmelo Licitra, Bradley A Connor, Sapha Barkati, Michelle Ngai, Kathleen Zhong, Ralph Huits, Davidson H
pmc-11512287.description: Background: The effect of the COVID-19 pandemic on healthcare systems emphasized the need for rapid and effective triage tools to identify patients at risk of severe or fatal infection. Measuring host response markers of inflammation and endothelial activation at clinical presentation may help to inform appropriate triage and care practices in patients with SARS-CoV-2 infection.

pmc-11540262.title: Pulse Oximetry Performance in Darkly Pigmented Skin: Methodological Concerns
pmc-11540262.creator: Vikrant Sharma, Steven J. Barker, Jerry Novak, William C. Wilson
pmc-11540262.description: ical limitations, which undermine the scientific rigor and render the study conclusions as invalid. The first methodological error is the failure to standardize the sensor type and anatomic locations studied. The Masimo device was tested using both ear and finger measurements, whereas the Nellcor device was tested using only finger measurements.

pmc-11643257.title: Women’s narratives of experiences, drivers and consequences of mistreatment during maternity care in western Ethiopia
pmc-11643257.creator: Habtamu Kasaye, Vanessa Scarf, Annabel Sheehy, Kathleen Baird
pmc-11643257.description: BackgroundThe mistreatment of women during maternity care hinders quality care globally and deter women from seeking health services. To implement necessary actions, it is essential to explore instances of mistreatment, their factors and negative outcomes. This study explores the narratives of mistreatment experienced by women, its drivers, as well as the consequences of mistreatment.

pmc-11713633.title: Implementation analysis of community‐based centers for people with dementia and their family caregivers in Chile
pmc-11713633.creator: Jean Gajardo, Josefina Aubert, Ximena Moreno, Jose M Aravena, Felipe Carcamo, Maria T Abusleme, Carolina Barrientos, Franco Mascayano
pmc-11713633.description: BackgroundCommunity‐based centers for people living with dementia (PLWD) have been implemented as part of the National Plan of dementia in Chile, delivering a multicomponent intervention to support PLWD and their families. There is limited knowledge on their implementation, and we had previously informed with respect to the implementation outcomes of the first center, called Kintun.

pmc-12586061.title: Elucidating the mechanism of soybean-derived protein hydrolysate in stabilizing rice yield and enhancing agronomic efficiency
pmc-12586061.creator: Shunchang Zhang, Lijuan Tang, Xing Zhan, Dianwen Wang, Anning Zhang, Hao Wu, Cheng Huang, Hongping Chen, Jilin Wang
pmc-12586061.description: IntroductionAs a type of biostimulant, protein hydrolysates (PHs) can promote crop growth, increase yield, and enhance crop tolerance to abiotic stresses. However, their application and research in rice production remain relatively limited.MethodsFocusing on“Lifenggu” (a soybean-derived protein hydrolysate), this study carried out multilocation field trials to evaluate the real-world application efficacy of this biostimulant on rice production across varying environmental conditions.

pmc-12623890.title: Comparative thermoelastic analysis of semiconductors with an external heat source under three theories
pmc-12623890.creator: B. Das, N. Islam, A. Lahiri
pmc-12623890.description: This article explores the three-dimensional thermoelastic problem in a homogeneous, isotropic rectangular plate subjected to an external heat source and an electromagnetic field under three theories: nonlocal classical coupled dynamical theory (NLCDC), nonlocal Lord-Shulman theory (NLLS), and nonlocal dual phase-lag theory (NLDPL).

pmc-12652713.title: MicroRNA-210 Suppresses NF-κB Signaling in Lipopolysaccharide-Stimulated Dental Pulp Cells Under Hypoxic Conditions
pmc-12652713.creator: Xiyuan Bai, Nobuyuki Kawashima, Shihan Wang, Peifeng Han, Mayuko Fujii, Keisuke Sunada-Nara, Ziniu Yu, Takashi Okiji, Yoshio Yahata, Erika Cione
pmc-12652713.description: Dental pulp tissue, enclosed within rigid dentin, is susceptible to bacterial invasion via dentinal tubules, often leading to severe pulpal inflammation. This condition is typically associated with a hypoxic microenvironment, yet the mechanistic link between hypoxia and inflammation remains unclear. We identified a marked upregulation of microRNA-210 (miR-210) in human dental pulp cells (hDPCs) cultured under hypoxic conditions.

pmc-13082382.title: Rising detection of congenital pulmonary airway malformations and a pragmatic institutional algorithm: a four-patient thoracoscopic case series
pmc-13082382.creator: Simone Oliver Senica, Marko Bogovic, Katja Schmidhofer, Bernhard Kienesberger, Gabriele Gritsch-Olipp, Johannes Schalamon
pmc-13082382.description: Congenital pulmonary airway malformations (CPAM) are rare lung anomalies increasingly detected through prenatal imaging. Management of asymptomatic patients remains controversial, particularly regarding imaging strategy, timing of surgery, and malignancy risk. We report a four-patient case series treated at a regional pediatric surgical center between February and June 2025, representing an increased local incidence.

pmc-13198001.title: A lightweight TcrLM model predicts T cell receptor and epitope binding specificity
pmc-13198001.creator: Chenpeng Yu, Xing Fang, Shiye Tian, Judong Luo, Hui Liu
pmc-13198001.description: SummaryImmune responses depend on specific interactions between T cell receptors (TCRs) and peptides presented by antigen-presenting cells (APCs). The vast diversity of the TCR repertoire makes accurate prediction of TCR-antigen binding specificity highly challenging. Here, we present a lightweight, masked language model, tcrLM, to address this problem.

pmc-13383425.title: Primary nasopharyngeal Kaposi’s sarcoma without cutaneous manifestations: a case report
pmc-13383425.creator: Emmanuel L. Lugina, Zakayo Magembe Ernesti, Emanuel Livin Nundu, Angela Tabian Mlole, Felister Tupa, Herriethsiah StanleyNoah, Chacha Josiah Mwita, Innocent J. Mosha, Salama Iddy, Crispin Andrew Kahesa, Owen Ngalamika, Charles Wood, Julius David Mwaiselage, Salum J. Lidenge
pmc-13383425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundKaposi’s sarcoma (KS) is a neoplastic lymphovascular disorder. It typically appears on the skin of the upper and lower extremities, but can also occur on the mucosal surfaces of the head and neck. The most common site reported for head and neck injuries is within the oral cavity, particularly on the palate, and other mucosal sites, such as the nasopharyngeal area.

pmc-13405549.title: Temporal Transcriptomic Changes in the Cingulate Cortex of Neuropathic Pain Mice
pmc-13405549.creator: Guo-Quan Yao, Zhen-Ru Yuan, Xin-Tong Qiu, Cheng-Guo Jiang, Chong Zhang, Si-Zhe Feng, Guang-Xi Piao, Hong Ma, Zi-He Zhu, Yu-Gang Diao, Felipe Fregni, Yang Bai
pmc-13405549.description: Background: Neuropathic pain (NP), a debilitating condition resulting from nervous system lesions, is poorly managed by current therapies. The cingulate cortex is crucial for affective pain processing, yet a comprehensive spatiotemporal understanding of its molecular changes in NP is lacking.

pmc-13554438.title: Korean red ginseng saponins ameliorate metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis in mice by inhibiting caspase-11 and NLRP3 inflammasomes
pmc-13554438.creator: Eojin Kim, Hee Ryeong Lim, Deok-Hyeong Choi, Young-Su Yi

pmc-13578227.creator: Ying Wang, Xin Liu, Zhonghua Zhao, Dapeng Xu, Bangqin Huang, Ping Sun
pmc-13578227.description: Anticyclonic eddies (ACEs) restructure resources and drive trophic cascades, yet depth-resolved effects on nanoflagellate bacterivory remain unclear. We quantify bacterivory by phago-mixotrophic nanophytoplankton (PMNP) and heterotrophic nanoflagellate (HNF) using fluorescent-bead incubations in a warm-core ACE in the South China Sea.
